name: Happy Ghast+
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: Melworks
description: Happy Ghast+ improves tamed Happy Ghasts on the server with a more compact size, fire resistance, and more reliable riding/menu behavior. Java players can join without installing any client-side mods, since all features run server-side.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
